title: Philips 5000 Series Kettle $42 (via Price Check Button) + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ The Good Guys
body:
Deal: Philips 5000 Series Kettle $42 (via Price Check Button) + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ The Good Guys

[Prads] Have some brown colour changes on plate after 6 month of use any issues you encountered ? Or maintenance I am missing ?
[LolwutMikka] Is the 7000 series ever on sale? Need temperature control.
[Blitzfx] Right now $74 with price beat, but it occasionally drops to $69 https://www.thegoodguys.com.au/philips-7000-series-kettle-bl…
and $64 from Amazon one time
[sanow] I have been using it for a while. It is ok except the seal of the lid is poorly designed. Water leaks everywhere if you are used to pour water into the mug. You just need to be really careful when using it
[XedeX] Does the 7000 have this problem again ? Any idea ?
[Caped Baldy] it's overblown. Either pour slower or put a finger on the lid to minimise the gap.
[tonester] apparently some can’t pour without overpouring
[Zacard] Agree. Terrible lid. Definitely won’t be getting it again.
[HitlersDad] is this all metal? Anyone comment how smooth it pours?
[vaskothefrog] Not all-metal. Exterior is plastic. Smooth it pours? I wouldn't buy this for pourover if that's what you're asking about.
[Ooops] All metal apart from 1 small slip which only meets hot water when pouring.
Not sure what you mean by how smooth it pours. I've had mine for 3 years and I pour with the lid open so I don't run hot water over the plastic bit.
[Naoki] good price but pass. I don't like kettles with open-ended handles. I've had one hook something which tipped the boiled jug over, almost a disaster.
[Ooops] It's all metal, that's the difference with this one. Not many like it.
[quick-dry] scary, I can't be the only one who read this and then immediately looked over to note what handle the kettle in kitchen has.
[aparasher] Didn't I buy it for $35 few months ago from Good Guys??
[itstuan] Ah just bought this from Amazon for $47. Can't be bothered returning it.
[lNomNoml] Wouldn't this be better? https://www.officeworks.com.au/shop/officeworks/p/russell-ho… $6 more yes but might not have the lid/seal issues mentioned below
